title: Joe Rogan Experience #1439 - Michael Osterholm
summary: Joe Rogan interviews epidemiologist Michael Osterholm in March 2020 about the coronavirus. They cover how it spreads, masks, hygiene, social distancing, school closures and vaccine timelines.
why: During early Covid, HN recommended it as an in-depth, informed explanation of transmission and outbreak dynamics.

quote.text: I urge everyone of you to watch this interview and to be more informed.
